table.name: TLGNR_ORDER_CREATION_TYPE_BS
table.description: Describes the way an order was created in the Logon system. The standard way is 1=by an employee of the call center (in the application directly, based on a customer fax or phone call). 2=Order is placed via the Web Frontend. 3=Order is generated by Logon itself, for example an automatically generated return order for rail.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
